svg.aria-label: Genie-Proof Prompts, card back: Reads your prompt as a hostile genie hunting ten kinds of loophole, then rewrites it airtight. Shows what the genie would have done and flags every guess it made so you can correct it.
svg.text: Reads your prompt as a hostile genie hunting
ten kinds of loophole, then rewrites it airtight.
Shows what the genie would have done and
flags every guess it made so you can correct it.
“If a hostile literal reading exists, the prompt is not done.”
